title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude computer use (beta) opens to Team and Enterprise plans (Nov 20)
bullets.summary: Anthropic's release notes say computer use is now in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, rolling out to organizations gradually, with an admin setup guide.
bullets.how: The Construct: a sanctioned, org-level path for the desktop tasks Hermes and the AP-Agent Mac now handle, so check whether our org has it and pilot one runner task (e.g. Signs365 cart steps) against it. Brand 9 Signs: vendor-portal work with no API. PRAGMA: a clean recommendation for clients already on Team or Enterprise.

bullets.title: Google gives the Gemini Mac app computer use (Nov 19): it can operate Mac apps, fill forms and organize local files
bullets.summary: Google's Gemini app for Mac can now carry out multi-step tasks across desktop apps and websites, starting in English for US Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers.
bullets.how: The Construct: with Claude computer use opening to Team/Enterprise the same week, desktop agents are now a two-vendor commodity, so the moat is our runbooks and gates (Signs365 cart steps, vendor portals), not the driver; keep runner tasks vendor-neutral. Brand 9 Signs: no-API vendor portals become automatable on either stack. PRAGMA: clients will ask which desktop agent to pick, so have a side-by-side ready.

bullets.title: Siemens shows an agent that turns a text prompt into a print-ready robot gripper by driving its CAD software over MCP (Formnext, Nov 16-20)
bullets.summary: Built with AGIBOT, the agent picks a gripper type, adapts geometry in Siemens Designcenter, simulates it, checks the robot interface and prepares the print file, calling the engineering software's functions through the Model Context Protocol.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: the same prompt-to-fabrication chain (pick template, adapt geometry, check against machine limits, export cut/print file) is what our CNC and vinyl pipelines do by hand, so wrap our CAD/CAM steps as MCP tools with a geometry gate before export. The Construct: a big-vendor proof that MCP reaches into desktop CAD, not just SaaS. PRAGMA: a citable manufacturing case for operator clients.

bullets.title: OpenAI details Performance Factory (Nov 19): Codex agents diagnose ChatGPT slowdowns and propose fixes for engineers to approve
bullets.summary: OpenAI describes an internal system where Codex agents investigate latency regressions in ChatGPT, find the cause and propose fixes, with engineers reviewing before anything ships; Databricks shipped the same pattern for data jobs as Genie ZeroOps the same day.
bullets.how: The Construct: two vendors converged on 'agent diagnoses, proposes a fix as a PR, human approves', which is the right template for the site-health sentinel and scheduled-task triage agents (they should open a fix, not just report). PRAGMA: a citable, primary-source example of safe self-healing ops. Brand 9 Signs: brand9signs.com site repairs via the sentinel.

bullets.title: Tasks in Gemini goes free in six countries (Nov 17): the agent calls businesses, buys through AP2 and Google Wallet, and runs in isolated cloud VMs
bullets.summary: Google made its Tasks agent free in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, with business phone calls, purchases via the Agent Payments Protocol, links to 60+ apps, and Universal Commerce Protocol support listed as next.
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: consumer agents will now phone the shop and buy on customers' behalf, so the phone line, quote answers and checkout must work for an agent caller, and AP2/UCP readiness joins the ChatGPT-shopping checklist. The Construct: hardware-isolated VMs per task is the sandbox pattern to copy for unattended runners. PRAGMA: talking point on agent-ready storefronts.

praxis_lesson: This week agents left the browser on both ends: Siemens drives desktop CAD through MCP to produce a print-ready part, while Gemini and Claude agents operate desktops and phone businesses for consumers. For The Construct and Brand 9 Signs, expose our own fabrication steps as gated MCP tools and make the shop answerable to agent callers and buyers, rather than waiting for a vendor to do either.
